messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Vendor EIN verification options — PO on hold (W-9 / bank letter / DocuSign)

Hi Sabrina,

Thanks for the quick intake on onboarding Nostrum. Procurement is ready to issue the PO once we have acceptable EIN verification and a signed W-9 (or equivalent). Currently the PO (draft attached) is in hold status pending evidence.

We can accept one of the following (choose whichever is easiest for you):
- Signed IRS W-9 (PDF) with EIN visible and signer name/title. Notarization preferred for passthrough entities but not strictly required.
- Notarized bank letter on official bank letterhead confirming the entity name and EIN (bank verification letter).
- DocuSign-signed W-9 using an e-sign flow that includes signer email verification + audit trail (we will accept if DocuSign identity verification has a level of assurance — see below).

If you go the DocuSign route, we need either basic identity verification (email + access) or the extra ID verification step (what DocuSign calls "ID Check"). If you prefer the bank letter, please have it include bank contact details and the bank rep name/phone.

Attachment: Redwood_PO_45067_draft.pdf (pdf)

Can you let me know which you can provide and an ETA? If it helps, we can open a short (15-min) call to walk through the DocuSign template.

Best,
Mateo
Sr. Procurement Ops | Redwood Inference

Few quick Qs:
- Is a scanned notarized bank letter acceptable, or do you need the original mailed?
- If we use DocuSign, is an in-person notary required? Our finance team can do DocuSign with ID check if that speeds things up.

Attached is our company registration page exported (for reference). Happy to route whatever is fastest.

Attachment: Nostrum_registration_2028.pdf (pdf)

Subject: Re: Vendor EIN verification options — PO on hold (W-9 / bank letter / DocuSign)

Hi Sabrina — quick answers and path forward: 

1) Scanned notarized bank letter is acceptable to move the PO forward. We do not require the physical original up front, but procurement will need to keep a copy of the notarized scan and we may request originals later for audit.

2) DocuSign with ID Check is acceptable in lieu of notarization. If you choose DocuSign, please use the template at the link below or confirm your vendor can generate a W-9 using DocuSign and include the audit trail; we need the signer name, title, date, and the EIN on the document.

3) Required fields for acceptance: legal entity name, EIN, signer full name, signer title, date, and either bank rep name/phone (for bank letter) or DocuSign audit link.

Suggested next steps:
- Option A (fastest): Send notarized bank letter scan today — we can unblock the PO upon receipt.
- Option B: Send DocuSign-signed W-9 with ID Check — please paste the DocuSign audit URL in your reply.

If helpful, we can do a 15-min screen share to confirm the W-9 fields before you sign.

DocuSign template: https://na.docusign.com/template/abc-verify-ein
Procurement ticket: https://procure.redwood.internal/tickets/PR-7842

Thanks — Mateo

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Subject: internal: acceptance criteria and recordkeeping for Nostrum onboarding

Internal note — copying the thread for the vendor: procurement confirms acceptance of either a notarized bank letter scan or a DocuSign-signed W-9 with ID Check. A few internal reminders: 

- Please capture the DocuSign audit URL in the vendor file (attach to PR-7842).
- If we receive a bank letter, ensure the scanned PDF includes the bank rep name and contact phone; flag if bank letter is missing contact info.
- For bookkeeping, we require the vendor legal name to match the PO entity exactly (no DBA discrepancies). If there is a mismatch, escalate to Legal before PO approval.
- Once we have the scanned evidence, procurement will mark the PO as "conditional released" and instruct finance to set payment terms. Original-doc retention: request the vendor to retain the original notarized doc for 7 years and provide on audit request.

Action items:
- Mateo: confirm which option vendor picks and attach evidence to PR-7842.
- Monica: if we move to DocuSign, please generate the vendor file and capture signature metadata.

Thanks,
Kimberly
